_note: Planning doc — Phase 2 detail. NOT a live entity. See ../campaign_arc.json for the big picture this breaks down from.
name: The One Who Got Away
goal: The party learns about the possessed former student and locates them.

antagonist_operation.thornwick_connection: The former student first encountered the Thornwick Arcane Consortium (existing faction, already tied to completed Session 5) during a student expedition. Which expedition is not yet specified — placeholder.
antagonist_operation.after_graduating: They approached Thornwick directly, intending to subvert their former school by any means necessary.
antagonist_operation.method: They are the source of the corrupting magical items behind all three Phase 1 incidents (the catalog item, the tainted component pouch, the angry instrument) — supplied/arranged through Thornwick and delivered onto campus via an unidentified 'inside person.'
antagonist_operation.phase_boundary_note: None of this belongs in Phase 1 — the party doesn't learn about the former student or the Thornwick connection until Phase 2. Phase 1 only establishes that incidents are happening and that the veil exists.

the_insider.decision: CONFIRMED — Torvald Thatch (existing NPC, head groundskeeper/night watch). Not evil — an unwitting instrument, corrupted via a cursed ring given to him by the former student as a 'thank you' gift. Redeemable if the ring is removed. Full depth (backstory with the former student, how the ring works, what he knows, interrogation guidance, open removal-mechanism options) is in torvald_the_insider.json.
the_insider.why_him: Campus-wide unsupervised access (groundskeeper + night watch), no pre-existing 'suspicious' tag to spoil the reveal, and his established discretion/don't-report-it personality (see his existing content file) is exactly what the ring exploits — it doesn't fight his character, it wears it.
